title: Ensure 'Network security: Do not store LAN Manager hash value on next password change' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network security: Do not store LAN Manager hash value on next password change to 'Enabled'
reason: LM hashes are relatively weak and can be cracked quickly using brute-force attacks.

title: Ensure 'Network security: LAN Manager authentication level' is set to 'Send NTLMv2 response only. Refuse LM & NTLM'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Network security: LAN Manager authentication level to 'Send NTLMv2 response only. Refuse LM & NTLM'
reason: The LM authentication protocol is inherently weak. NTLMv2 provides stronger authentication security.

title: Ensure 'Accounts: Limit local account use of blank passwords to console logon only' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Accounts: Limit local account use of blank passwords to console logon only to 'Enabled'
reason: If this policy is disabled, any user with a blank password could log on to the computer over the network, potentially granting unauthorized access.
